inc-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — multiple GPU driver resets detected in hosted inference pool. 12 container restarts in last 10m, error spike on model-serving pods. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1772005123 :rotating_light:
Robin (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm looking. Node implicated: k8s-gpu-65.region1. Pod failures show OOM and then driver resets. Pulling logs now.
Maria G: Seeing same. Customers: 3 tenants with elevated 5xx and timeouts. CS flagged Ana.
Ana (CS): Confirmed two customers reported degraded latencies in the last 8 minutes. They're ondedicated/region1. Keeping them posted.
Robin (oncall): dmesg from k8s-gpu-65 shows repeated ECC/Xid entries. Posting snippet:
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.457890] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.458901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, Class 0b, ch 0000bf, eng 00000000, intr 001c04
```
Robin (oncall): Also seeing ECC corrected/uncorrected counts rising. Possible hardware degradation or driver bug.
Li (eng-runtime): Which driver version? Node reports nvidia-driver 535. Driver known issues around 535.x on A100 with certain kernels.
Jin S: We'll need to isolate node and drain traffic. Plan: cordon + drain -> restart nvidia driver -> monitor. If resets continue, reboot node and escalate to infra/hardware.
Taylor O: I'm scaling up spare pool to absorb traffic. Patching routing to avoid region1 for new inference requests in the meantime.
Robin (oncall): Doing cordon and graceful drain on k8s-gpu-65 now. Command: ```kubectl cordon k8s-gpu-65 && kubectl drain k8s-gpu-65 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60```
Robin (oncall): Drain in progress — 6 pods evicted, 2 stuck due to local storage, forcing restart of those pods.
Aj Patel: I'll take the restart and driver check. Running `modinfo nvidia` and `nvidia-smi -q` now.
Aj Patel: nvidia-smi shows GPU offline after Xid. Attempting to unload and reload modules: ```sudo systemctl stop kubelet && sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia && sudo modprobe nvidia && sudo systemctl start kubelet```
Maria G: Please keep CS looped. Ana — we've cordoned the node and scaled traffic away; some in-flight requests may have retried.
Ana (CS): Noted. I'm messaging affected customers: brief update, mitigation in progress, next update in 30m or earlier if resolved.
Aj Patel: Module reload completed. dmesg shows no new Xid lines in last 30s. Restarting the pods that were on that node to confirm stability.
Robin (oncall): Monitoring error rate. Metrics show decline but still a few spikes. Could be residual.
Li (eng-runtime): Fast mitigation entry: if driver reload stabilizes, leave node cordoned until we validate repeatability for 1 hour. Otherwise schedule maintenance window and repro. Also create node-level support ticket with cloud provider for ECC logs.
Jin S: Agreed. Action items: 1) Keep node cordoned for 1h 2) Collect full dmesg + ecc/syslog and attach to ticket 3) If Xid reappears, reboot and isolate from pool 4) Open hardware escalation ticket.
Taylor O: I've shifted traffic and bumped up dedicated pool capacity by 20% to absorb sustained load. No new customer errors reported in the last 5m.
Robin (oncall): Handoff: I'm on for another 25m then need to hand to Aj for overnight monitoring. Aj, can you take on-call if things look stable?
Aj Patel: I can take over. I'll stay on for the handoff in 25m and check again after 30m of quiet.
Maria G: Filing follow-up ticket and postmortem starter: PM-1772. Will include timeline, dmesg, mitigations, and recommended next steps (driver downgrade vs hardware swap).
Ana (CS): Sending customer update: "We've identified GPU driver resets on a node in region1 and routed traffic away. We're monitoring — next update in 30 minutes."
Robin (oncall): Final note before handoff: keep node cordoned, do not recommission until we've validated >1h stability and checked ECC counters. If any new Xid lines appear, escalate immediately to infra with ticket link.
inc-bot: Incident update recorded. Severity: P1 -> Partial mitigation achieved. Create postmortem when incident is closed.
Aj Patel: Taking over on-call. I'll post a status update in 30m.
Maria G: Thanks team.
__notes: This thread is a simulated realistic Slack incident conversation covering driver resets, ECC/Xid logs, mitigation (cordon/drain, module reload), traffic shift, customer comms, and on-call handoff. All fields are strings or lists of strings per agents.md constraints.
